source_edits.old: alpha = tl.math.exp(m_i - m_ij)  # Update factor: exp difference between old and new max
source_edits.new:
alpha_base = tl.math.exp(m_i - m_ij)
        alpha = alpha_base * 1.0  # Metamorphic identity

cases.description: Split and reconverge the row denominator to introduce a diamond-shaped SSA subgraph.

source_edits.old: l_ij = tl.sum(p, 1)  # Softmax denominator (sum of each row)
source_edits.new:
l_ij_base = tl.sum(p, 1)
        l_ij_left = l_ij_base * 0.5
        l_ij_right = l_ij_base - l_ij_left
        l_ij = l_ij_left + l_ij_right  # Diamond reconvergence

cases.description: Feed the denominator from independent sum and max reductions of p.

source_edits.old: l_ij = tl.sum(p, 1)  # Softmax denominator (sum of each row)
source_edits.new:
l_ij_sum = tl.sum(p, 1)
        l_ij_peak = tl.max(p, 1)
        l_ij = l_ij_sum + l_ij_peak * 0.125  # Parallel reductions

cases.description: Add a second nonlinear alpha consumer before denominator convergence.

source_edits.old: l_i = l_i * alpha + l_ij  # Update softmax denominator
source_edits.new:
alpha_aux = alpha * alpha
        l_i = l_i * alpha + l_ij + alpha_aux * 0.125  # Parallel alpha consumer

cases.description: Make the row denominator feed both l_i and the matrix accumulator branch.

source_edits.new: acc_ptr = acc_ptr * alpha[:, None] + l_ij[:, None] * 0.001
